notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Delina triggers, creating at least one Composite Golem token.
Activate a Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
